# Vendored external skills

Skills under this directory are copied bodies of externally-owned skills, not
locally authored OMP skills.

**`registry.yaml` is the canonical provenance ledger.** Every retained vendored
directory carries a `.sync-meta.json` fetch record pinned to upstream content.
The local `global/skills` tree is the OMP authority; do not keep a second local
copy of an external skill there unless the catalog explicitly treats the local
copy as the maintained OMP adaptation.
